intro.lead: Create stunning, flowing ribbon animations for your website with just a few lines of JavaScript. tsParticles Ribbons adds beautiful, physics-driven ribbon effects that enhance your site's visual appeal without slowing it down.
intro.sub: Whether you're building a celebration effect, an interactive background, or a subtle ambient animation, ribbons provide an elegant solution that works everywhere — no plugins, no flash, just pure HTML5 Canvas.

lightweight.title: Lightweight & Fast
lightweight.text: The entire ribbons bundle weighs just a few kilobytes gzipped. Animations run at 60fps using hardware-accelerated Canvas rendering, ensuring smooth performance even on mobile devices.

zeroDependencies.title: Zero Dependencies
zeroDependencies.text: Use it with a simple script tag or install via npm. No jQuery, no React, no build tools required — though it integrates seamlessly with all major frameworks.

customizable.title: Fully Customizable
customizable.text: Control colors, physics, positioning, and timing. Create anything from subtle background effects to dramatic celebration bursts with just a few configuration options.

crossBrowser.title: Cross-Browser Compatible
crossBrowser.text: Works in all modern browsers including Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. Graceful fallback for older browsers — your site stays functional everywhere.

frameworkSupport.title: Framework Support
frameworkSupport.text: Official packages available for React, Vue.js, Angular, and Svelte. One-line integration with dedicated components that handle canvas lifecycle automatically.

openSource.title: Open Source
openSource.text: MIT licensed and backed by the tsParticles community. Full source code available on GitHub with comprehensive documentation and examples.

usecases.title: Perfect For
usecases.launches: Product launches & announcements: Celebrate new releases with eye-catching ribbon bursts that draw attention to your message.
usecases.holidays: Holiday & seasonal themes: Add festive ribbon animations for holidays, sales events, or special occasions.
usecases.backgrounds: Interactive backgrounds: Create engaging ambient effects that respond to user interactions without distracting from your content.
usecases.gamification: Gamification & rewards: Trigger ribbon animations when users complete actions, earn achievements, or reach milestones.
usecases.portfolio: Portfolio & creative sites: Add a unique visual element that makes your portfolio stand out from the crowd.
usecases.ecommerce: E-commerce & conversions: Highlight special offers, discount reveals, or successful purchases with celebratory effects.

basic.name: Basic Ribbons
description: The default mode... ribbons fall from random positions across the top of the page with default colors and physics.

colors.name: Custom Colors
description: You can customize the ribbon colors to match your brand or theme. Use any hex, rgb, or named color.

multiple.name: Multiple Bursts
description: Spawn multiple ribbon bursts with staggered timing for a layered cascading effect.

continuous.name: Continuous Fall
description: Why click a button repeatedly when you can have code do it for you? Spawn ribbons continuously for 8 seconds from random positions.

fixedPosition.name: Fixed Position
description: A single burst of ribbons from a fixed point (x: 50, y: 0) — useful for triggering from a button or specific element.

customCanvas.name: Custom Canvas
description: You can limit where the ribbons appear by providing your own canvas element. Great for keeping ribbons within a specific section of your page.

ribbonsConfetti.name: Ribbons + Confetti
description: Combine ribbons with confetti for a double celebration effect. Confetti rains from above while ribbons flow across the screen — perfect for product launches, milestones, and holiday greetings.
